Option Explicit
Dim s,p,n,f,log,sh,rc
Set s=GetObject("winmgmts:\\.\root\cimv2")
Set f=CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
Set sh=CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set log=f.CreateTextFile("C:\SPF_USB_VALIDATION\final-launch.txt",True)
n=0
For Each p In s.ExecQuery("SELECT * FROM Win32_Process WHERE Name='Spitfire.exe'")
n=n+1
Next
If n<>0 Then log.WriteLine "Blocked existing original": log.Close: WScript.Quit 10
log.WriteLine "Isolated simulator only; launch original before USB capture; startup2047 rejected by fixture."
rc=sh.Run("C:\SPF_USB_VALIDATION\launch-original.cmd",0,True)
log.WriteLine "Original launch command exit=" & rc
WScript.Sleep 15000
n=0
For Each p In s.ExecQuery("SELECT * FROM Win32_Process WHERE Name='Spitfire.exe'")
n=n+1
log.WriteLine "Original pid=" & p.ProcessId & " path=" & p.ExecutablePath
If LCase(p.ExecutablePath)<>"c:\program files\spectra-physics\spitfire\spitfire.exe" Then log.Close: WScript.Quit 11
Next
If n<>1 Then log.WriteLine "Blocked original count": log.Close: WScript.Quit 12
rc=sh.Run("C:\SPF_USB_PACKAGE\START.cmd",1,True)
log.WriteLine "Actual USB START.cmd exit=" & rc
log.Close
WScript.Quit rc
